account: It is day 0, about 09:02. I came from home to town hall and read the appointment book. Today calls for morning office correspondence, a 10:00 market walk in the plaza, lunch at home at noon, town accounts at 13:00, tea with the neighbour at a dockside cottage on the east bank at 15:00, office at 16:30, and home at 19:00. I returned the book to its chest. The secretary is nearby holding a writable book; I asked about correspondence and town news, but have not heard an answer. Several townsfolk have passed within sight near the plaza, including Townsfolk 04, 28, 08, and 06. I have not observed anything unusual or evidence of a special undertaking. Their movements may simply be ordinary morning business; I do not know their purposes.
